definitions.explanation: The nature of the relationship or connection between two or more people. Focuses on the quality or closeness of the relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|した}しい→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧{間柄|あいだがら}だ。
⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧{間柄|あいだがら}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What kind of relationship do those two have?

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}い{合|あ}える→言い合う：21474_iiau⟧{間柄|あいだがら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be on terms where we can say anything to each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{間柄|あいだがら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧、⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧し⟦{合|あ}っている→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: They trust each other beyond the boss-subordinate relationship.

notes:
{間柄|あいだがら} describes the nature or quality of a relationship between people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{親|した}しい→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧{間柄|あいだがら} (close relationship)
- ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧{間柄|あいだがら} (what kind of relationship)
- {間柄|あいだがら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧ (beyond the relationship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: broader term for "relationship" including non-personal contexts
- {間柄|あいだがら}: specifically about interpersonal relationships and their quality
- ⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧: focuses on how well people get along (⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ = on good terms)
